description: A free-flying camera (freecam) mod for Fabric Minecraft 1.21.11 with a toggle/hold key, rebindable keybind, and Mod Menu settings screen.

mods.name: FreecamPlus
mods.description: A free-flying camera you can toggle or hold to fly around and look at your build/world without moving your actual player. Fully rebindable key, toggle or hold activation mode, and a config screen.

releases.notes:
FreecamPlus 2.3.0 for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric).

### Fixed
- **Crash when joining a world** — the keyboard-input mixin no longer shadows fields that live on the parent class, which was throwing an `InvalidMixinException` on world load.

### New
- **Smooth camera** — the freecam is interpolated every frame, plus an optional **Smooth Movement** easing for gentle acceleration/deceleration.
- **Scroll to change speed** — spin the mouse wheel while flying to adjust fly speed instantly.
- **Fullbright** — optionally light up the world fully while in freecam.
- **Waypoints** — press **B** in freecam to open a **Create Waypoint** dialog: choose a name and a color (including a **custom hex color**). Waypoints render in the world with a **live distance readout (m/km)** like a minimap, you can place multiple, and clear them all from the dialog.

### Requirements
Fabric Loader 0.19.0+, Fabric API, Java 21. [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) is optional but recommended for the settings screens.

Put `freecamplus-2.3.0.jar` and Fabric API in your `mods` folder.
